summary: Iteration 135 - narrow third-pass retest of the 3 issues from iteration_134 on Inbound STO Receipt. (1) BADGE ROTATION FIX 1 IS NOW VERIFIED FIXED live: with a seeded running job the badge container computed animationName='none', transform='none', height=16px, and only the <svg> icon carries class 'shrink-0 animate-spin' with animationName='spin' (rotating transform matrix on the icon only). Screenshot confirms 'Processing — est. 3 min remaining' renders horizontally on one line inside its own row with no smear into rows below. (2) Failed-vs-Done badge FIX VERIFIED: by mocking receive-status responses in the browser (no real SAP writes), a job with status='done' + result.status='failed' rendered a RED 'Failed' badge (rgb(180,35,24)) with tooltip = the humanized error, while status='done' + result.status='received' rendered the GREEN 'Done' badge (rgb(2,122,72)). (3) receipt_error sanitization FIX IS ONLY PARTIALLY EFFECTIVE - _humanize_sap_error() itself works (unit-probed: extracts the OData value/message key, caps unknown strings at 120 chars) but it is applied only on the WRITE path (finalize_receipt); list_pending_receipts returns doc['receipt_error'] verbatim, so every pre-existing row still leaks raw payloads: GET /api/inbound-receipts/pending -> STO-000057 receipt_error is still 289 chars of 'P8D1-192: HTTP 500: {"error":{"code":"ERROR","message"...' and it is visibly rendered on the row (see screenshot). STO-000054 (471 chars) leaks Playwright internals ('Locator.click: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. Call log: - waiting for locator("[aria-label=...]")') and STO-000067 leaks 'SAP login did not reach the launchpad - check credentials/session state'. Light regression all PASS: bulk select (2 orders selected bar + 'Receive Selected (2)'), non-blocking confirm dialog open/cancel, Clear, row expand with per-line items, single-receive dialog open/cancel, Queued badge, Receive button+checkbox disabled while a job is live, active_job rehydration after fresh page load, Stock Transfer detail modal SHIP STATUS column (headers 9/9, table scrollWidth 972 == wrapper 972, no h-scroll), 0 console errors on every page. Backend regression: pytest tests/test_batch_receive_iter134.py -> 14 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed. No files were created or edited under /app/backend/** (all probes in /tmp); seeded synthetic job docs TEST-ITER135-PROC/QUEUE were deleted afterwards.

minor.issue: receipt_error is still returned verbatim from the STO doc - _humanize_sap_error() is only applied inside finalize_receipt() on new writes, so all existing rows keep leaking raw payloads to end users: STO-000057 = 289-char raw '{"error":{"code":"ERROR",...}' JSON, STO-000054 = 471 chars including Playwright 'Locator.click: Timeout ... waiting for locator("[aria-label=\"Inbound Delivery Notifications\"]")', STO-000067 = 'SAP login did not reach the launchpad - check credentials/session state'. Fix: run receipt_error through _humanize_sap_error() (or a display-level sanitizer) in list_pending_receipts, and/or one-off backfill the stored values.

The 120-char fallback truncates but does not sanitize: internal automation wording ('Locator.click', 'waiting for locator(...)', 'SAP login ... credentials/session state', 'Save failed / Message Strip Error') still reaches the user inside the first 120 chars. Also the per-delivery join means a 3-delivery failure can still produce ~380 chars total even though each part is capped at 120.

rca_of_the_issue: receipt_error leak: _humanize_sap_error() was added to finalize_receipt()'s error_summary construction only. Rows whose receipt failed before the fix (or any other code path writing receipt_error) keep their raw value in Mongo, and list_pending_receipts serializes doc['receipt_error'] as-is, so the UI still renders the raw '{"error":{...}}' blob and Playwright locator timeouts. Sanitizing at serialization time (and/or a one-time backfill) closes it permanently.
